text:
Anna (PM): Quick alignment - I want a concise customer-facing "Handover Manifest" and a short internal GA gating checklist for Private installs where the customer controls networking. Keep it punchy for sales/field, and a separate internal checklist for Eng/NetOps/SRE.

Raj (Eng): Sounds good. From engs POV the minimum technical guarantees we can make: rolling agent upgrades that preserve workloads, a documented rollback toggle that restores prior agent + egress assignments, and signed artifacts for airgap installs. Also need a preflight that outputs machine-readable exit codes + human hints.

Marta (Field): Field asks: manifest must include 1) named Network Owner contact, 2) declared ASN(s) and egress pools, 3) firewall/ACL change windows, 4) DNS cutover plan and TTL guidance. If customers won't lower TTLs we must note expected propagation behavior.

Kyle (NetOps): NetOps requirement: a mandatory BGP dry-run that validates egress continuity and AS-path sanity. Installer should produce an "egress-fingerprint" (CSV/JSON) we can reconcile against the customers announced prefixes. NetOps signoff required before any production cutover.

Jia (SRE): Observability minimums: upgrade_progress_percent, agent_version_set, node_egress_mappings, postcutover_error_rate. We also need an event timeline that maps operator actions to system events. Telemetry must be opt-in and support a pre-send sanitization step using customer KMS. Include a 1-page troubleshooting playbook for the top 6 failure modes.

Leah (Legal): Add a short, plain-language liability bullet for the customer doc: we do not accept responsibility for misconfigured customer network devices or third-party appliances; customer must sign acceptance of those limits. Keep legal wording friendly but clear.

Omar (Support): From support: include a simple escalation ladder in the manifest (field lead -> netops -> eng oncall) and whether the customer chose assisted mode (we dispatch an operator) or self-service. Note included operator hours and billable rates for extra time.

Raj (Eng): Proposed short Handover Manifest layout (one-paragraph + checklist):
- Manifest header: network owner name/email, ASN(s), declared egress CIDRs, agreed maintenance window, selected install mode (assisted / self-service)
- Preflight gates: network reachability, required ports, disk/kernel check, NAT/iptables scan, egress-fingerprint validated
- Dry-run gates: BGP handoff simulation (netops verifier), egress-fingerprint reconciliation, smoke traffic test, customer sign-off
- Upgrade gates: canary (configurable) -> staged roll; rolling agents, non-destructive by default
- Rollback gates: rollback toggle + script to restore prior agent + egress mapping; target RTO for supported configs documented
- Packaging: online installer + sha256-signed airgap bundle + staged signer metadata
- Observability & privacy: minimal metrics + event timeline; telemetry sanitization step; KMS envelope support
- Support & commercial: included operator hours outlined; extra hours billable; escalation ladder in manifest
- Exclusions & limits: customer BGP misconfig, third-party NAT boxes, unsupported kernel patches, physical hardware faults

Marta (Field): For the customer-facing sheet keep it to 6 bullets max and a single signoff line: "Network Owner: name / email / signature / date". Also include a 1-line expectation on DNS: "If TTL >300s expect extended dual-path routing; recommend TTL <=60s for cutover."

Kyle (NetOps): Ill produce the netops dry-run verifier and the expected schema for the egress-fingerprint (fields: prefix, node-id, expected-egress-ip, signed-by). Also add the exact verifier commands we run. ETA: Tue EOD.

Jia (SRE): Ill publish the minimal metric names and a 1-page runbook with queries for quick triage (example queries included). Also a short script for telemetry sanitization that customers can run before sending logs. ETA: Wed AM.

Raj (Eng): Ill own the preflight binary + machine exit codes and the rollback script. Ill also add a small IP-preservation test harness (opt-in) that produces a pass/fail report. ETA: Tue EOD.

Omar (Support): Ill draft the escalation ladder text and the included vs billable hours snippet for the customer one-pager. ETA: Wed noon.

Leah (Legal): Ill draft the signoff sentence for the manifest and the short liability/exclusions phrasing. ETA: Wed EOD.

Anna (PM): GA gating proposal: require at least two distinct customer-verified cutovers on different network topologies before GA. Each cutover must: pass preflight, pass NetOps dry-run, complete canary->full roll, exercise rollback at least once (can be simulated), produce egress-fingerprint reconciliation, and have a signed post-cutover report from field + network owner. Additionally require one of the verifications to be performed under constrained-control-plane conditions (airgap-like).

Marta (Field): Strong agree. Field wants multiple topologies to avoid repeated mid-market regressions. Also require a 24-48h soak window after cutover with metrics stability check.

Raj (Eng): Agreed. Define "successful": preflight green, dry-run pass, canary promoted, rollback exercised (or simulated) without IP drift, metrics within baseline during soak window, signed post-cutover report.

Kyle (NetOps): Also require NetOps signoff for each cutover. For airgap tests, require verifying artifact signatures and manual manifest reconciliation.

Anna (PM): Owners recap: Raj = preflight + rollback + opt-in harness; Kyle = dry-run verifier + egress schema; Jia = metrics + runbook + sanitization; Marta = customer-facing manifest + post-cutover report template; Leah = signoff/legal lines; Omar = escalation & ops hours text. Ill stitch the customer 1-pager and the internal GA checklist and circulate for signoff by Fri COB.

deploy-bot: New internal doc uploaded: /docs/private-deploy/handover-manifest-template-v1.md

Marta (Field): Noted  will review draft and add two customer FAQ blurbs from recent deals. :eyes:
